cases.rationale: Several actual people are visible, including the woman in shorts and the person wearing the pink hat. The red upright structure and narrow dark doorway at the left could be a bus doorway, but this saved crop lacks enough vehicle context to establish that; bus remains unclear. No passenger-car or truck-specific part is identifiable. The patterned garment and necklaces are not an identifiable backpack, handbag or necktie; the pink hat is not an umbrella. I considered all 75 definitions across the whole crop; no other listed category object is identifiable.

An actual woman in a black sleeveless top fills the crop against a distressed wall. Her hands meet around a partly cut-off red and black camera-like item at the lower border; it has no identifiable phone, remote, bottle or fruit features. The wall markings are not actual objects in the listed categories. I considered all 75 definitions, including small handheld objects and clothing accessories; no other listed object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real passenger airplane dominates the foreground, with fuselage, cockpit, wings, engines, tail and landing gear visible. Small standing airport workers are visible behind it near the left. Yellow airport service trucks with cab/body and wheels appear at the right, with another partial service vehicle at the edge. These are ground service vehicles rather than identifiable passenger cars or buses. Cones, ladders, terminal walls and tarmac markings do not establish traffic signals, hydrants or stop signs. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; no other listed object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual baseball player stands on the grass wearing a uniform and cap, with an identifiable dark fielding mitt on his hand. A large out-of-focus bird with head, beak and body silhouette occupies the upper right foreground; it is an actual bird rather than a kite or image on an object. No other equipment category is identifiable on the field. I considered all 75 definitions across both foreground and background; no other listed object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.
